Name: Dora's Drills Deluxe
Author: Doragoun
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sCrfQoK.png[/img]﻿

Once you have made a bit of progress in the mines and gotten closer to a certain old miner, you will receive a mail containing the first of four drill weapons to get you started. You can upgrade this drill at Clint's shop (not the tool upgrade option, the regular shop) as long as you carry it in your inventory. For the last upgrade as well as a special little goodie that permanently increases the chance for ladders to spawn from both slain monsters and broken rocks, you should visit a certain little guy speaking a foreign language on a faraway island.

If a monster is slain while you're holding a drill, the chance for a ladder to spawn is increased, with the specific increase depending on which tier your drill is. They are balanced around the weapons you can obtain when you get your hands on the necessary upgrade materials, but they're a little weaker in exchange for increasing the ladder spawn chance.

Sounds intriguing and you want to know more? Great! For more details about the specific upgrades, needed materials and the technical nitty gritty, just click the following spoiler:
[SPOILER][b]Prerequisites for obtaining the first letter[/b][list]
[*]500 friendship points (= two hearts) with George
[*]reached level 15 in the mines
[/list][b]Details about the drills[/b]
1st tier: Worn-Down Drill[list]
[*]obtained from the initial mail (see above)
[*]5 - 10 damage (dagger) / 5 - 20 damage (sword)
[*]increases ladder spawn chance by 25% multiplicatively
[/list]
2nd tier: Miner's Choice
[list]
[*]upgrade purchasable from Clint's shop
[*]upgrade materials: 1000 gold, 20 iron ore
[*]10 - 20 damage (dagger) / 20 - 35 damage (sword)
[*]increases ladder spawn chance by 50% multiplicatively
[/list]
3rd tier: Diamond Drill
[list]
[*]upgrade purchasable from Clint's shop
[*]upgrade materials: 3000 gold, 3 diamonds
[*]20 - 30 damage (dagger) / 30 - 50 damage (sword)
[*]increases ladder spawn chance by 75% multiplicatively
[/list]
4th and final tier: Draconic Drill
[list]
[*]upgrade purchasable from the volcano dwarf's shop
[*]upgrade materials: 5000 gold, 5 dragon teeth
[*]35 - 50 damage (dagger) / 65 - 90 damage (sword)
[*]increases ladder spawn chance by 100% multiplicatively
[/list]
[b]Core Drill[/b]
[list]
[*]wallet item purchasable from the volcano dwarf's shop for 30 omni geodes
[*]permanently increases chance ladders for broken rocks and slain monster to spawn ladders by 3% and 10% additively, respectively
[*]row row, fight the power[/SPOILER]
[/list]There's a config that determines whether the drills act as daggers (default) or as swords. The animation makes more sense with daggers, but dagger combat kind of sucks, so the sword option exists if you don't  want to deal with that, lol. Keep in mind that the config will not retroactively apply to already existing drills, though, so you'll have to spawn in or otherwise obtain new ones if you change it mid-save!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/sgtIh0y.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35477]Ladder Chance Framework[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31832]PeliQ[/url]﻿.
[*]Download this mod from the files section.
[*]Unzip the downloaded file.
[*]Move it to your mods folder.
[*]Spin around a few times to get into the right mood.
[*]Done.
[/list]
